description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering the user password recovery page, including layout setup, dynamic content insertion, and form handling.

methods.name: text_widget
methods.description: Generates a widget based on the provided text identifier.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Retrieves localized or configured text string by key.

methods.name: text_html

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Defines the layout template for the page.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Finalizes the template rendering, replacing the placeholder with actual content.
